records.title: Greenhouse Gas Emissions By Sector, Annual
records.footnote: Prior to 2022, the emissions profiles did not include hydrofluorocarbon (HFC) emissions from the Refrigeration and Air Conditioning (RAC) sector under the Industry sector emissions. The estimated excluded HFC emissions from the RAC sector in 2021 and 2020 amount to around 4.0 MtCO2e and 3.1 MtCO2e respectively.
